title.narrative: Saint Lucia Urban Resilient Flood Investment Project

description.narrative: (i) enhance resilience to floods in selected areas, and (ii) strengthen the Government's capacity for managing climate-related risks.

The project aims to (i) enhance resilience to floods in selected localities, and (ii) strengthen the Government's capacity for managing climate- and disaster-related risks. These components are: (a) Institutional and System Strengthening: infrastructure planning, design, management and preparedness; (b) Enhancing resilience and sustainability of critical infrastructure; and (c) Project Management. Component 1 will support the development of detailed engineering designs and construction supervision for selected flood mitigation investments within the Castries and Anse La Raye areas, while also strengthening the Government of Saint Lucia's capacity to prepare for and manage the impacts of natural hazards and climate change. Component 2 will support the implementation of prioritized activities designed under component 1, which will support an integrated river basin approach toward urban flood risk management and reduction.
